scope: Frozen retail Dev policies; exact expectation over independent per-field response availability. Controlled documents and manager conditions, not organizational effectiveness.

registration.responseModel: Independent Bernoulli missingness per c/p/v/b request channel. Enumerate all 16 patterns with common outcomes across policies; do not reveal availability until the relevant request. No parameter selection, no Test or frozen 27-source holdout inference.
registration.interpretation: Descriptive Dev sensitivity with fixed checkpoints. This finite expectation removes response-draw variation; it does not add independent retail observations or establish real manager behavior. Preserve original order-dependent historical results separately.
registration.correction: Copy unavailable or partial states only from actual observed replies with preserved source applicability; reject unavailable before any observed failed reply. Raw head predictions and all numeric evidence remain separate.
registration.acceptance: For each of the three fixed policies and all three preregistered missingness probabilities, preserve financial value/type/evidence correctness and no additional false handoffs or redundant requests; reduce resolved-state errors without increasing complete-period total loss. No assertion of learned-head improvement from deterministic observed-state validation. Do not use Test or the frozen 27-source holdout.

sourceAudit.scope: Frozen complementary snapshot plus source-disjoint original Train sales; no latent demand or organizational efficacy claim

timingScope: All condition rollouts with cached deterministic states and decisions; not an operational latency benchmark

trainAudit.scope: Status transition diagnostic on fixed historical observed Train states, not sequential model effectiveness. Numeric/evidence/type fields preserved. No Dev/Test or hidden environment labels enter the transition.

generatedComparison.scope: Original generated Dev comparison of observed response-state validation. Same frozen encoder, field/type/state heads, demand GRU and action heads. This is a state transition correction, not learned extraction improvement.

registration.acceptance: On original generated Dev, do not increase actual total loss, invalid handoffs, or financial value/evidence/type errors; improve or preserve resolved state accuracy. Every raw head prediction remains traceable. Only then run the full fixed retail response-condition comparison; no new Test or frozen 27-source inference. Three fixed policies are all reported; no weight selection or changes.
